messages.author: 6d87204efd6aa482
messages.subject: MLR & Fit Statistics in Version .6-7
parts:
Hi all,

I am having some trouble getting the robust test statistic and associated fit indices (CFI, TLI, etc.) for a series of bivariate latent growth curve and random intercept cross-lagged panel models in a sparse (cohort-sequential) dataset with N=440 participants. For some of these models/variable combinations, lavaan returns NAs for these indices, and RMSEA point estimates & CIs are .00. There are no clear problems with the standard ML (not robust) statistics or convergence issues, so it seems to be specific to MLR.

I didn't have this problem when I ran the same models on the same data in the spring prior to updating to .6-7. I'm not certain whether I was using .6-6 or .6-5 at the time. The standard stats match up pretty well with what I got previously, but the robust stat issue is new. Was something changed in the update that would explain this problem, and what can I do to remedy it?

I found this github discussion that covers a similar issue, but from 2018 (so it would not be the same exact issue as mine), and the proposed solution (h1.information = "unstructured") does not help. Any help you can offer would be appreciated! Sample code for the bivariate LGCM below.

b.lgcm <- ' Intercept.X =~ 1*x1 + 1*x2 + 1*x3 + 1*x4 + 1*x5
          Linear.X =~ 0*x1 + 1*x2 + 2*x3 + 3*x4 + 4*x5
          Intercept.Y =~ 1*y1 + 1*y2 + 1*y3 + 1*y4 + 1*y5
          Linear.Y =~ 0*y1 + 1*y2 + 2*y3 + 3*y4 + 4*y5 '
fit.lgcm <- growth(b.lgcm, data=data, missing = "FIML", estimator="MLR", em.iter.max = 20000)
summary(fit.lgcm, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
